finding: The newly merged Trigger1 V2 atomic lease gate scans sibling claims using literal trigger_key equality only. The current GO_EXPERIMENT_ATOMIC_LEASE_PROTOCOL requires a post-claim migration/race fence that also rejects legacy or noncanonical encodings of the same immutable request identity, or the same exact timestamp plus payload digest. Historical repository claims contain such dashed-local-time and compact-short-digest forms, so exact string equality leaves a reachable false-admission class.
counterhypothesis: Canonical trigger-key validation alone is sufficient because historical noncanonical claims cannot equal the new canonical claim path.
adjudication: Rejected. The protocol explicitly says different string formatting of the same timestamp/payload identity does not create a different macrocycle, and historical claim records demonstrate those variants exist.
delta: Normalize canonical timestamp trigger identities to UTC microsecond form.
Recognize historical dashed local-time claim keys and compact offset claim keys.
Treat historical 12-64 hex payload suffixes as semantic-race prefixes only, never as canonical identity.
Reject same normalized timestamp plus matching payload digest/prefix with EXPERIMENT_BUDGET_RACE_VIOLATION.
Use a legacy filename stem as the race-fence identity when a sibling claim JSON is malformed, so corrupted legacy evidence cannot silently reopen the experiment slot.
Add positive and negative deterministic regression definitions for full-digest, short-digest, malformed-file and unrelated-timestamp cases.
next_exact_gate: Execute tests.test_trigger1_atomic_lease_gate plus the current Trigger1 promotion-gate regression on this exact successor head. Fuse only if current, nonduplicate and green. Do not dispatch the unusual midlayer intervention without an already-created valid canonical claim for the exact experiment schema.
